summary_hint: Origination agreement between <borrower> and <broker/originator> (NMLS <org_nmls_id>), dated <agreement_date>, compensation <broker_compensation_method>.

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: identity/source — the originating organization on the letterhead

typed_core.name: creditor_or_lender_name
typed_core.why: identity/disambiguator — the lender when named; distinguishes broker vs creditor comp

typed_core.name: organization_nmls_id
typed_core.why: identity/compliance — org NMLS license id; primary compliance key (CORE)

typed_core.name: individual_originator_name
typed_core.why: identity — the licensed individual (flattened from person)

typed_core.name: broker_compensation_method
typed_core.why: processor/compliance — borrower-paid vs lender-paid; the central compliance fact
typed_core.prompt_hint: BPC vs LPC is mutually exclusive — only one compensation amount field should be populated; capture the method verbatim

typed_core.name: exclusivity_indicator
typed_core.why: processor — whether the borrower is bound exclusively

typed_core.name: agreement_term_or_expiration
typed_core.why: processor — how long the agreement binds

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: identity linkage (flattened) — ties to the subject file

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: identity linkage — ties to the loan file

nested_lists.name: origination_and_broker_fee_items
nested_lists.shape_reason: fee schedules list several {fee_name, amount} lines; flat rows are light and adapt to varying fee counts. The one list with a plausible future consumer (fee/comp reconciliation against the Loan Estimate). Item count is modest (typically <15), well under the token ceiling

fields.name: amount
fields.why: the fee/comp amount for fee-comp reconciliation against the Loan Estimate

rejected.name: form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: not a single standardized form across brokers

rejected.name: statement_period_start/end
rejected.reason: an agreement has no coverage period

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: duplicate the named parties; no per-party rule

rejected.name: loan_amount_or_requested_terms
rejected.reason: requested terms have no consumer here; captured in URLA/1003

rejected.name: originator_services, borrower_obligations
rejected.reason: narrative lists with no rule; catch-all

encoding_variations: broker_compensation_method (enum, null): 'Borrower-Paid Compensation' (BPC) vs 'Lender-Paid Compensation' (LPC) — determines which of the two comp amount fields is populated; capture the method beside the amount (§3)
broker_or_agent_relationship (enum, null): 'agent', 'independent contractor', 'not acting as your agent' — prose varies
exclusivity_indicator (boolean) stated as a clause, not a checkbox — degrade to str
Two NMLS numbers appear (organization and individual) — keep distinct; the org id and individual id are different registries

open_questions.q: origination_and_broker_fee_items vs the comp scalars — the list may double-count borrower_paid_compensation.
options: keep both the fee list and comp scalars, flag the overlap for the reshaper
drop the fee list until a fee-reconciliation rule is planned
open_questions.recommendation: keep both but flag the overlap for the reshaper; confirm whether a fee-reconciliation rule is planned before investing the ~5 sites of list plumbing

options: promote to a second flat list
open_questions.recommendation: catch-all now; promote to a second flat list only if state-licensing validation becomes a rule

open_questions.q: Comp method as the compliance anchor — broker_compensation_method degrades from enum to str.
open_questions.recommendation: if a comp-compliance rule is built, confirm whether a controlled vocabulary/coercer should be added

notes: No rules in the packet -> no rule floor. The agreement establishes the broker/originator relationship and the compensation structure (borrower-paid vs lender-paid comp, NMLS licensing); every field is justified by identity or processor review. NMLS ids and comp method are the fields a future compliance rule would most plausibly read.

NMLS ids are public license identifiers, not PII — retained as identity/compliance fields. loan_number (confidential) treated as identity/linkage. No SSN/DOB/account number on this agreement; no new _PII_FIELDS entries.

Prompt hint (spans organization_nmls_id and individual_nmls_id): distinguish organization NMLS id from individual originator NMLS id — both are always present on a compliant agreement; mislabeling inverts the compliance check.
Prompt hint (doc-level): the broker/originator, the creditor/lender, and the borrower are three distinct parties — do not conflate broker with lender.
Prompt hint (doc-level): money stays a string in value, coerced to Decimal on read.
state_license_numbers (object[]) is a genuine repeat (one row per state) but no rule reads it — left to the catch-all as compliance reference detail.
